data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Wikipedia visa article, then timeanddate holidays, then a note) with the right three parameters in the right order. Its only flaws are a minor {country}/{destination_country} naming inconsistency in the note template, plus a vague extra "Save the note" step where the true workflow presses Enter and doesn't say how to switch tabs.
